run_pseudo_decomp_bert_nsp: run the BERT-NSP pseudo-decomposition script to find nearest-neighbor short questions for hard HotpotQA questions
build_batch_bert_inputs: build BERT input tensors with input_ids, segment_tensor, and attention_mask for NSP scoring batches
index_easy_questions_faiss: index L2-normalized SQuAD question embeddings into a FAISS inner-product index for fast nearest-neighbor search
score_question_pairs_nsp: score short question pairs using BERT NextSentencePrediction model for pseudo-alignment
dump_pseudoalignments_results: dump pseudo-alignment results including hard questions, matched short questions, and pair strings to a data folder
